title: Craig's Seasons
description: A Minecraft plugin to give your server unique and configurable datapack driven seasons!
body:
**Craig's Seasons**

A relatively advanced plugin which intends to bring some of the real world to your Minecraft server!

There are four seasons which follow the same names as their real life counterparts.

Spring
![A "minecraft:forest" with our default spring colormapping!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f86d07d3b9e808a78c6bd8e7f6be40ff28731e6.png)

Summer
![A "minecraft:forest" with our default summer colormapping!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46edf967d9dbd9ae7cf899ad1255771408fa242f.png)

Autumn
![A "minecraft:forest" with our default autumn colormapping!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5a7fdad408a54aaa9d314107580770a2bcfc42.png)

Winter
![A "minecraft:forest" with our default winter colormapping!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/854bf84728d4750c46428d9c9a9b060bb36f50e6.png)


Some key features:

- Fully configurable groups, you can add additional biomes and colormaps as you please!
- Image based colormapping, know what colors you are using visually
- Importing from AdvancedSeasons, fast and automatic
- Support for datapacks with custom biomes
- Easy uninstall command
- Biomes caching, your original world biomes will never be lost
